notes: 2.13.21 (Rust binary): user-agent 'Forge', 'x-title: forge', 'x-app-version: vv<version>' and 'http-referer: https://forgecode.dev' on every request of both protocols — chat completions (OPENAI_URL) and the Anthropic messages API (ANTHROPIC_URL), hence family 'any'. Each run first lists GET /v1/models, then sends a title side request (identity 'You are Title Generator', json_schema response format, no tools) before the main request; two consecutive system messages (the agent prompt, then <system_information>). The Anthropic variant capitalises Read, Write and Task. Identical on the first turn, after the tool call and on the --conversation-id follow-up.
